text.p: Guinean authorities have detained a freelance journalist for alleged breach of security at a ceremony last week attended by President Lansana Conte, police sources said on Monday.

They said that Foday Fofanah, a Sierra Leonean who works part time for British Broadcasting Corporation radio and Reuters, had been held at Conakry's central prison since last Tuesday when he was arrested.
Fofanah had not been brought to court but had been allowed to see his lawyer, the sources said.

Local journalists said Fofanah was arrested after he approached Conte with a microphone as the president arrived for the opening of a meeting of the Islamic Development Bank in Conakry last Tuesday. He told police he had not breached presidential security.
